en.title: ACS Recommends Regular Prostate Cancer Screening for Men 50 to 69
en.dek: The American Cancer Society updated guidelines on Thursday, 12 November 2026, recommending regular prostate cancer screening for average-risk men aged 50 to 69.
facts: The American Cancer Society issued new guidelines on Thursday, 12 November 2026.
Men aged 50 to 69 at average risk should undergo a blood test every two years.
Black men and men with a strong family history should start annual screening at age 45.
Screening can continue through age 75, with individual decisions starting at age 70.
body: The American Cancer Society reported the updated guidelines on Thursday, 12 November 2026, recommending prostate-specific antigen (PSA) blood testing every two years for men aged 50 to 69 at average risk.
High-risk groups, including Black men and men with a strong family history, are encouraged to receive annual screening starting at age 45, according to the American Cancer Society.

Robert Smith, senior vice president of early cancer detection science at the A.C.S., cited a European randomized controlled trial showing a 13 percent lower risk of death from prostate cancer among regularly screened men after 23 years.
The guidelines suggest limiting overdiagnosis by recommending two elevated PSA readings followed by an MRI scan and/or other biomarker testing before proceeding to biopsy.
en.context: Prostate cancer accounts for about 2.5 percent of all deaths among U.S. men, according to the American Cancer Society; the previous guideline from 2010 left the decision to test to the individual and their doctor.

de.title: ACS empfiehlt regelmäßige Prostatakrebsvorsorge für Männer im Alter von 50 bis 69
de.dek: Die American Cancer Society hat am Donnerstag, den 12. November 2026, aktualisierte Leitlinien veröffentlicht und empfiehlt durchschnittsrisikobetroffenen Männern im Alter von 50 bis 69 Jahren regelmäßige Prostatakrebsvorsorge.
facts: Die American Cancer Society hat neue Leitlinien am Donnerstag, den 12. November 2026, herausgegeben.
Männer im Alter von 50 bis 69 Jahren mit durchschnittlichem Risiko sollten alle zwei Jahre einen Bluttest durchführen lassen.
Schwarze Männer und Männer mit starker Familienanamnese sollten ab dem 45. Lebensjahr jährliche Vorsorgeuntersuchungen beginnen.
Vorsorge kann bis zum 75. Lebensjahr fortgesetzt werden, individuelle Entscheidungen beginnen ab 70 Jahren.
body: Die American Cancer Society gab am Donnerstag, 12. November 2026, die aktualisierten Richtlinien bekannt, die für Männer im Alter von 50 bis 69 mit durchschnittlichem Risiko eine Prostataspezifisches Antigen (PSA)-Bluttestung alle zwei Jahre empfehlen.

Hochrisikogruppen, darunter schwarze Männer und Männer mit starker familiärer Vorbelastung, sollen laut American Cancer Society ab dem 45. Lebensjahr eine jährliche Vorsorgeuntersuchung in Anspruch nehmen.

Robert Smith, Senior Vice President für die Wissenschaft der Früherkennung von Krebs bei der A.C.S., verwies auf eine europäische randomisierte kontrollierte Studie, die bei regelmäßig untersuchten Männern nach 23 Jahren ein um 13 Prozent geringeres Sterberisiko durch Prostatakrebs zeigte.
Die Richtlinien empfehlen, eine Überdiagnose zu vermeiden, indem sie zwei erhöhte PSA-Werte als Voraussetzung für eine MRT-Untersuchung und/oder andere Biomarker-Tests vor einer Biopsie vorschlagen.
de.context: Prostatakrebs macht nach Angabe der American Cancer Society etwa 2,5 Prozent aller Todesfälle bei US-Männern aus; die vorherige Leitlinie von 2010 überließ die Entscheidung zum Test dem Einzelnen und dessen Arzt.

pt.title: ACS recomenda rastreamento regular de cancro da próstata para homens entre 50 e 69 anos
pt.dek: A Sociedade Americana do Cancro atualizou as suas diretrizes na quinta-feira, 12 de novembro de 2026, recomendando rastreamento regular de cancro da próstata para homens de risco médio entre 50 e 69 anos.
facts: A Sociedade Americana do Cancro emitiu novas diretrizes na quinta-feira, 12 de novembro de 2026.
Homens entre 50 e 69 anos de risco médio devem submeter-se a um teste de sangue a cada dois anos.
Homens negros e homens com história familiar forte devem iniciar rastreamento anual aos 45 anos.
O rastreamento pode continuar até aos 75 anos, com decisões individuais a partir dos 70 anos.
body: A Sociedade Americana de Cancro divulgou as novas diretrizes na quinta-feira, 12 de novembro de 2026, recomendando testes de sangue de antigénio prostático específico (PSA) a cada dois anos para homens entre 50 e 69 anos em risco médio.
Grupos de risco, incluindo homens negros e homens com história familiar forte, são encorajados a receber rastreamento anual a partir dos 45 anos, segundo a Sociedade Americana de Cancro.

Robert Smith, vice-presidente sénior da ciência da detecção precoce de cancro da A.C.S., citou um ensaio controlado aleatório europeu que mostrou um risco 13 por cento menor de morte por cancro da próstata entre homens regularmente rastreados após 23 anos.

As diretrizes sugerem limitar o diagnóstico excessivo recomendando duas leituras de PSA elevadas seguidas de uma ressonância magnética e/ou outros testes de biomarcadores antes de proceder a uma biópsia.
pt.context: O cancro da próstata representa cerca de 2,5 por cento de todas as mortes entre homens nos EUA, segundo a Sociedade Americana do Cancro; a diretriz anterior de 2010 deixou a decisão de testar ao indivíduo e ao seu médico.

zh.title: ACS 建议 50 至 69 岁男性定期筛查前列腺癌
zh.dek: 美国癌症协会周四（2026年11月12日）更新指南，建议平均风险男性每两年进行一次前列腺癌筛查。
facts: 美国癌症协会周四发布新指南
50 至 69 岁平均风险男性每两年应进行一次血液检测
黑人男性及有强家族史者应从 45 岁开始每年筛查
筛查可延续至 75 岁，70 岁后决定个人是否继续
body: 美国癌症协会周四（2026年11月12日）发布了更新的指南，建议平均风险男性每两年进行一次前列腺特异性抗原（PSA）血液检测。
对于高危人群，包括黑人男性及有强家族史者，美国癌症协会建议从45岁开始每年接受筛查。
美国癌症协会早期癌症检测科学高级副总裁罗伯特·史密斯引用一项欧洲随机对照试验数据，显示在定期筛查23年后，男性死于前列腺癌的风险降低了13%。
指南建议通过限制过度诊断来遏制筛查误差，建议在进行活检前，先出现两次升高的PSA读数后，再进行MRI扫描和/或其他生物标志物检测。
zh.context: 前列腺癌占美国男性全部死亡人数的约 2.5%，据美国癌症协会称。2010 年之前的指南将检测决定权留给个人和医生。

ko.title: 미국암학회, 50~69세 남성 정기 전립선암 검진 권고
ko.dek: 미국암학회가 2026년 11월 12일 목요일에 가이드라인을 업데이트하며 평균 위험군 남성에게 50세에서 69세까지 정기적인 전립선암 검진을 권고했다.
facts: 미국암학회는 2026년 11월 12일 목요일에 새로운 가이드라인을 발표했다
평균 위험군 50~69세 남성은 2년마다 혈액 검사를 받아야 한다
흑인 남성과 가족력 고위험군은 45세부터 매년 검진을 시작해야 한다
검진은 75세까지 계속할 수 있으며, 70세부터는 개인의 결정에 따른다
body: 미국암학회는 2026년 11월 12일 목요일에 업데이트된 지침을 발표하며, 평균 위험군 남성의 경우 50세에서 69세까지 2년마다 전립선특이항원(PSA) 혈액 검사를 권고했다.
미국암학회에 따르면 흑인 남성 및 가족력이 뚜렷한 남성 등 고위험군은 45세부터 매년 검진을 받을 것을 권장한다.
A.C.S.의 조기암 발견 과학 수석 부사장인 로버트 스미스는 23년간 정기 검진을 받은 남성에서 전립선암으로 인한 사망 위험이 13% 낮았다는 유럽 무작위 대조 시험 결과를 인용했다.
이 지침은 과잉 진단을 제한하기 위해 PSA 수치가 두 번 높게 나온 후 조직 검사 진행 전에 MRI 검사 및/또는 다른 바이오마커 검사를 받도록 권고한다.
ko.context: 미국암학회에 따르면 전립선암은 미국 남성 사망 원인의 약 2.5%를 차지하며, 2010년 이전 가이드라인은 검사 여부를 개인과 의사의 결정에 맡겼다.

problemsFixed: The headline is not a factual statement of what happened and is too general.
The dek is too long and not a concise summary.

The facts list contains a claim about the U.S. Preventive Services Task Force's stance that needs careful attribution and context, as the sources only state they have not changed guidelines since 2025, not that they currently recommend against routine screening.
The body uses 'announced' instead of neutral verbs like 'stated' or 'reported' for the ACS.
The body structure is too dense; paragraphs need variation in length and must open with the actor, number, or date.
The context sentence uses 'about 2.5 percent' which needs attribution, and the description of the 2010 guideline is slightly vague.
The language needs to be strictly plain and avoid any evaluative framing.
